s.n: Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip
s.note: Omi, the only one who knows what is coming
s.how: Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip each in 2L simmering water with 60g bicarb for 30 seconds. Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g soft butter, 50g cream cheese, 2 tbsp lager, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds and finely diced red onion. Serve the pretzels warm with the dip and cornichons.

Slowly cook 3 thinly sliced brown onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil over low heat for 35 minutes until jammy and deep brown. Add 1 tsp Worcestershire and a splash of water and scrape the pan, then cool. Mix with 250g sour cream, 100g cream cheese, 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt. Chill 30 minutes. Top with 3 tbsp crispy fried shallots and more chives and serve with 200g kettle chips.

m.note: the tense family dinner before the storm
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince, add 700g passata and simmer 20 minutes. Make a white sauce from 40g butter, 40g flour and 500ml milk. Layer with lasagne sheets, top with 150g mozzarella and bake at 180C for 40 minutes.

w.n: Krampus gingerbread men with jagged grins
w.note: the gingerbread men that come to life
w.how: Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g dark brown sugar. Mix in 300g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp chilli powder and 1 egg to a soft dough. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut gingerbread men and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 150g icing sugar with 1 tbsp water and pipe jagged teeth, then add red eyes with a little tinted icing.

d.note: a freezing night snowed in with the power out
d.how: Pour 750ml red wine and 500ml cloudy apple juice into a saucepan. Add 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without letting it simmer. Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each. For non-drinkers, warm 1L apple juice with the same spices in a second pan.
